format_note: Same format as ../manifest.json (see ../README.md and rootcommit/SPEC_SIG.md). These two preimages differ from the parent directory's in one way that matters: they are ANCHORED. Their SHA-256 commitments are leaves 7511 and 7512 of markovianprotocol.com/log, covered by a witnessed checkpoint whose exact bytes carry an OpenTimestamps proof upgraded to Bitcoin block headers.

source_receipt.feed: sanctions-screen (self-screen of the operator's own custody Safe; no third-party subject data)
source_receipt.deadline_note: ~10 years on BOTH tiers - an archival-mode receipt, not the short-deadline test shape in the parent directory. The deadline is the only signed time-adjacent field in the struct; it is an expiry, not an observation time. Existence-before-T comes from the anchor below, not from anything inside the signature.
source_receipt.attestation_domain_note: eip155:421614 is Arbitrum Sepolia - a frozen, pre-audit EIP-712 SIGNING namespace, deliberately not a settlement rail. Settlement in the same receipt is Base mainnet (eip155:8453). Same split as the parent manifest, disclosed for the same reason.

delivery.signer_note: Current gateway attester, post the 2026-08-19 planned rotation; the previous attester is published machine-readably at x402.payperbyte.io/.well-known/agent.json -> receipt.retiredAttesters. The parent directory's delivery preimage predates the rotation and recovers to the retired key - both are genuine, on opposite sides of a disclosed boundary.
delivery.signature_note: EIP-712 PayloadAttestation signature, recoverable to `signer`. Carried alongside, NOT hashed into the commitment.

provenance.signer_note: sanctions-screen oracle signer, pinned in the live manifest at x402.payperbyte.io/.well-known/x402.json -> receipt.embedded.signers.
provenance.signature_note: EIP-712 PayloadAttestation signature, recoverable to `signer`. Carried alongside, NOT hashed into the commitment.

checkpoint.naming_note: Anchor filenames are checkpoint TREE SIZES, not leaf indices. A checkpoint at size 7513 covers every leaf below it, including 7511 and 7512.

anchoring.existence_before: 2026-08-20T04:51:53Z (timestamp of block 963257, the earliest attesting block)
verified_2026_08_20: inclusion: both leaves' c2sp.org/tlog-proof paths recompute to the checkpoint root at size 7513 (RFC 6962 leaf hash over exact leaf bytes)
checkpoint origin note signature: Ed25519, verified against the log's published vkey (key id match)
stamped bytes: SHA-256 of /anchor/7513.checkpoint equals the file hash committed in /anchor/7513.ots

bitcoin: all three BitcoinBlockHeaderAttestation digests in the .ots equal the merkle roots of blocks 963257/963258/963260 per two independent explorers (mempool.space and blockstream.info) - the log's own stated fallback rule when no local node is available
not_verified_here: witness cosignatures on the checkpoint (lines present; not checked by this contribution)
bitcoin headers against a locally validated chain (explorer cross-check only)
